body.x: Show Indoor Sports will participate in “CES 2018 (Consumer Technology Show)”, the world's largest IT appliance exhibition which will be held in Las Vegas, USA from Jan. 9th (Tue) to 12th (Fri) and is selected as “BEST OF MIK CES TOP10.”

Show Indoor Sports is a company with differentiated US original technology in the field of Virtual Reality Simulator business. From the hardware developed with the strong original technology patent to the creative virtual reality sports experience zone, Show Indoor Sports is promoting GLOBAL-MARKETING around the world as an innovative VR company that cannot be imitated by other companies.

In CES 2018, bobsleigh (VC301) as well as cycle (VC201) will be introduced. These products can be experienced by virtual reality so they are not affected by seasons and environment. The biggest advantage is that general people can learn about sports that are not easily accessible.

The slip-turn function on the curved track provides a realistic feel, and it is possible to implement more than 20 sports games with its own module patents. Moreover, by securing its own VR content developer and partner company, it is possible to provide a much more efficient system.

The main issues include signing of China manufacturing and sales MOU, opening of the first VR sports café (December 21, 2017), and supply of bobsleighs (December 24-31, 2017) to the event by Visa Card related to Pyeongchang Winter Olympic Games. During last Dec. 24th to 31st, at the 1st floor of Jamsil Lotte World Mall, a virtual reality (VR) bobsleigh match event was held at Visa Stadium. This event is to have bobsleighs games by VR, and is held first in the world by Show Indoor Sports (VR Carver) and Visa Card.

Meanwhile, “BEST OF MADE IN KOREA CES TOP10” selected only 10 companies among CES 2018 exhibitors by Aving News and foreign reporters such as the US and China considering the trend of the company, growth rate, and prospects. During the exhibition period, each media will select the TOP 3 through final screening and announce it officially on the last day of the exhibition.

CES, The world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
